title: The SDLC You Build Yourself — Andy Wong, Andrei Bocan & Shane Wolf, Atlassian
talk_summary: Atlassian presents its agentic SDLC tooling (Jira coding agent, AI reviewer, AutoDev, AI planner, context engine) built around a semantic code-context engine and human-in-the-loop gates. Most content is product marketing, but a few mechanisms are concrete: a trained noise-filter for review comments, WIP limits on agent-generated PRs, and human specification gates for underspecified backlog items.

takeaways.what_they_do: They train models to filter out low-value/nitpicky review comments before they reach humans, measuring human comment-resolution rate as the quality metric.
takeaways.numbers: ~40% human code resolution rate vs 45% human baseline

takeaways.technique: WIP limit on agent-generated PRs per human
takeaways.what_they_do: AutoDev caps how many PRs each engineer is assigned per week so agent output doesn't flood reviewers and stall in review.
When a backlog item is underspecified, the system pulls in a human to clarify acceptance criteria before the agent starts; agents verify against an explicit checklist.

takeaways.technique: Agentic code search over many repos instead of monorepo
takeaways.what_they_do: A code-context engine does agentic search scoped to likely locations across 15k repos, pulling live code plus historical decision docs, avoiding monorepo tooling debt.
takeaways.evidence_quote: narrowing down the retrieval and the search space to scope it to like where this answer is most likely

takeaways.what_they_do: Humans mark documents as verified/latest so retrieval favors authoritative sources over stale ones; recency is also favored.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the verified badge ... that's basically the thing that we use internally to say like yes cool this is like still the latest and greatest

takeaways.what_they_do: Model is chosen at the harness top level, and individual skills/sub-agents can pin a specific model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this is for this specific task, for this specific skill, I want this model, this sub agent needs to be using
